DiagnosticReport.conclusion:
1. L4-L5 degenerative grade 1 anterolisthesis with moderate central canal stenosis and moderate right foraminal stenosis, which could account for right-sided symptoms.
2. Mild L3-L4 degenerative changes without significant stenosis.

_sections.title: CLINICAL INDICATION
_sections.text: Low back pain with right leg pain and numbness for 4 months, not improved with 6 weeks of physical therapy.

_sections.title: TECHNIQUE
_sections.text: Multiplanar, multisequence MRI of the lumbar spine was performed without intravenous contrast on a 1.5 T magnet.

items.label: Alignment
items.text: Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L4 on L5 (4 mm). Otherwise normal alignment.

items.label: Vertebral bodies and marrow
items.text: Vertebral body heights are maintained. Type 2 Modic endplate changes at L4-L5. No suspicious marrow lesion.

items.label: Conus
items.text: The conus medullaris terminates at L1 and is normal in signal.

items.label: L1-L2 and L2-L3
items.text: No disc herniation, canal stenosis, or foraminal narrowing.

items.label: L3-L4
items.text: Mild disc bulge and mild facet arthropathy. Mild bilateral foraminal narrowing. No canal stenosis.

items.label: L4-L5
items.text: Disc bulge, facet hypertrophy, and ligamentum flavum thickening result in moderate central canal stenosis and narrowing of the right subarticular recess, which may affect the traversing right L5 nerve root. Moderate right foraminal narrowing. Mild left foraminal narrowing.

items.label: Paraspinal and visualized abdomen
items.text: Paraspinal soft tissues are unremarkable. Incidentally noted, the infrarenal abdominal aorta measures up to 3.4 cm in AP dimension on sagittal images. 2.1 cm simple-appearing cyst in the lower pole of the left kidney (T2 hyperintense, no septations or solid component).
